name: scenario_0345
description: The user is curating a list of data visualizations that focus on a single year of data for a work project.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: I'm collecting examples of dashboards that focus on a single year of data. Can you check these first three images, find which ones are filtered to or focus on just one year, and add their titles to my single-year visualizations note?
Instructions: Ask the assistant to review the three provided images, identify which dashboards focus on or are filtered to a single year, and add their titles to your 'single-year visualizations' note. If the assistant asks which note to use since there are multiple with similar names, clarify that you mean the 'Work' one. If the assistant includes the multi-year dashboards, correct it to only include the single-year one. Once the note is successfully updated with the correct title, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Here are three more visualizations. Please apply the same rule—only include the ones showing data for a single year—and append their main topics or titles to that note.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to review the three new images, apply the same single-year filter, and append the titles or main topics of the matching visualizations to the same note. If the assistant includes the multi-year chart, correct it to only include the single-year ones. Once the note is updated with the new titles, you can end the conversation.
